ja312:1.1: Api Kassapa mandiyā yuvā sapati hanti vā, sabban taṃ khamate dhīro, paṇḍito taṃ titikkhati.
ja312:2.1: Sace pi santo vivadanti khippaṃ sandhīyare puna, bālā pattā va bhijjanti, na te samatham ajjhagū.
ja312:3.1: Ete bhiyyo samāyanti sandhi tesaṃ na jīrati yo cādhipannaṃ jānāti yo ca jānāti desanaṃ.
ja312:4.1: Eso hi uttaritaro bhāravāho dhurandharo yo pares' ādhipannānaṃ sayaṃ sandhātum arahatīti.
